name: Are.na
summary: Platform for collecting images, links and files into channels — used as a visual research and moodboard tool.
description: Members save content into channels, privately or collaboratively, to build personal knowledge networks with no ads and no algorithmic feed. Free guest plan (up to 200 blocks); Premium adds unlimited blocks, advanced search and presentation mode. Open API v3, SDK and MCP resources for developers, plus iOS app and browser extensions.
